newsitem.title: UK: Highams comes to AIM with 6.4 million stg tag.
newsitem.headline: Highams comes to AIM with 6.4 million stg tag.

text.p: Highams Systems Services Group Plc said on Thursday it plans to list its shares on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) at 72p, valuing the company at 6.4 million stg.
The placing, by broker Teather and Greenwood, raised 221,000 stg net of expenses which will be used to fund expansion.
"We are very excited about Highams joining the Alternative Investment Market, which continues to be a successful marketplace for young companies to grow," said chief executive John Higham.
First dealings in the shares are expected on December 16.
